name: Stovkahra
summary: A four-player partnership point-trick descendant of Trappola played with German 32-card pack to 100 points.
rules_text: Four players in fixed partnerships face each other. Deal is 8 cards each in 3-2-3; first three of eldest are face up. Cards are shuffled only first deal; after, cut and show bottom card for trump suit. Before first trick, any player may declare three or four of a kind (not 9,8) for bonus: 40/30 for aces, 20/10 for tens/sevens, 12/6 for kings/knaves. Play is clockwise must follow suit, must trump if void, must beat current highest if able. Trick won by highest trump or highest led suit. Card points: ace 6, king 5, upper jack 4, lower jack 3. Bonus 6 for last trick, 10 for winning any middle trick with a seven, 26 for last trick with seven, 52 for first trick with seven of trumps. First team to think they have 100 says dost to stop and count; if wrong other team gets 2 brčka. First to 10 brčka wins match.
rating_reason: Historical trick-taking Trappola variant, specific partnership strategy game.
